title: Open Seminar; Provinces, (Critical) Zones, and Territories: An Itinerary Through Argentina, Chile, and Colombia
description: Space has become one of Postmodernity s central preoccupations and one could argue that cultural criticism produced what some have described as a spatial turn. Thus, countless studies have emerged that have mapped capital cities, borders, neighborhoods, migratory movements, and contact zones. This itinerary through Argentina's, Chile's, and Colombia's contemporary cultural practices will propose to revise this "spatial turn" by focusing on practiced places such as provinces, territories, and zones to rethink the local, and locality in order to reflect on a poetics of belonging.
